summary:
Two bugs, one needle each:

1. **`server.go:84`** — the server sent `+OK` before the WAL entry was fsynced. A `kill -9` between the buffer write and the background 100ms fsync lost acknowledged writes. Fixed by calling `s.wal.Sync()` before sending `+OK`.

2. **`test.sh:39`** — the grep `"LOST"` matched the word in the summary line `"0 LOST out of 50 acked"` even when nothing was actually lost. Fixed by anchoring to `"^LOST "` so it only matches individual lost-key lines.
